title: Prime Minister's Office (Smart Nation and Digital Government Group)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (Smart Nation and Digital Government Group)

sections.label: GoBusiness, digital economy, citizen services
sections.summary: SNDGG will enhance GoBusiness, support the digital economy, ease business innovation access, improve digital services like Singpass and LifeSG, and scale estate management solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Together with the Ministry of Trade and Industry, we will enhance the one-stop GoBusiness digital platform to support firms’ day-to-day transactions and longer-term investments, such as in equipping workers with future skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will work with the Ministry of Communications and Information to support the digital economy through initiatives like the SG Financial Data Exchange.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will make it easier for businesses to tap on the expertise of public research players for innovation, such as through the JTC-Singapore Institute of Technology Living Lab testbed, and the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA)-Smart Nation and Digital Government Office Jurong Lake District Innovation Challenge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Second, SNDGG will use technology to transform the lived experiences of citizens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will improve the convenience of digital services and transactions through applications, such as Singpass and LifeSG.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will also drive advancements in Singapore’s cyber-physical infrastructure with URA, including scaling innovative solutions in estate management from Punggol Smart Town to other districts.

sections.label: CheckWho and secure Government transactions
sections.summary: SNDGG will roll out CheckWho in end-2023 to verify calls from public officers and secure Government platform transactions with phishing detection and fraud analytics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: First, SNDGG will roll out the CheckWho product in end-2023 to help the public verify the legitimacy of calls from public officers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Second, SNDGG will ensure that transactions on Government platforms are secure and resilient with tools to better detect phishing sites that pose as Government agency websites, and fraud analytics solutions for Singpass.

sections.label: Digital First but not Digital-Only
sections.summary: SNDGG aims for Singaporeans to gain economic benefits and productivity in the digital age while building an inclusive, united and caring society that is Digital First but not Digital-Only.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Even as SNDGG aims to enable Singaporeans to reap economic benefits and productivity gains in the digital age, our fundamental aspiration is to build an inclusive, united and caring society that is “Digital First but not Digital-Only".
